fields.description: Users pick a company after login and see only that company's records until they switch.
fields.label: Enable Active Company

fields.description: Skip the picker for users who can access only one company.
fields.label: Auto-select When Only One Company

fields.description: Picking a group company shows it and every company under it. User Permissions still apply.
fields.label: Allow Group Companies

fields.description: Users with any of these roles see all companies and never get the picker. Administrator is always exempt.
fields.label: Exempt Roles

fields.description: Document types that stay shared across companies even though they have a Company field.
fields.label: Excluded DocTypes
